title: Zhipu AI's New Generation Large Model Roadmap Revealed: Parameter Count Exceeds Trillion, Dual-Track Technology Path Aims for AGI

content_html:
Leading Chinese artificial intelligence company Zhipu has recently released important technical signals regarding its new flagship large models GLM-5.4 and GLM-5.5. It is reported that these highly anticipated new models not only officially enter the trillion-parameter level in terms of parameter scale, but also open up two completely new exploration paths in the underlying technical architecture, marking another deep dive by domestic large models toward General Artificial Intelligence (AGI).

From the perspective of technological evolution, Zhipu's "dual-track new path" has attracted significant attention from the industry. On one hand, while pursuing extreme parameter scale, how to achieve an efficient balance between training and inference at such a massive scale has always been a core challenge in the global AI field. After entering the trillion-parameter level, the model not only has a greater potential upper limit in complex reasoning, long-text processing, and multi-modal understanding, but also places extremely strict requirements on computing power scheduling and algorithm optimization.

On the other hand, in response to the global trend of competition in large models shifting from simply competing on parameters to emphasizing "efficiency and effectiveness", Zhipu is exploring two entirely new technical routes in parallel, aiming to break through the performance bottlenecks of traditional architectures. Industry experts analyze that this forward-looking architectural layout helps maintain the model's strong generalization ability while significantly improving the processing efficiency of specific complex tasks, thus lowering the entry barriers for enterprise applications.

As the development of GLM-5.4 and GLM-5.5 progresses, domestic large models are accelerating their efforts to catch up with global top levels in ultra-large-scale parameter training and cutting-edge architecture innovation. In the future, the practical performance of this generation of trillion-parameter models in scenarios such as complex logical reasoning and industry-specific intelligent agents will become an important indicator for observing breakthroughs in China's core AI technologies.
